name: Bravo One
description: Bravo One was a UT-60D transport/gunship that served the Extraction Team Bravo of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War. Under the command of General Davits Draven, in 1 BBY, the Bravo Team took a successful mission to break out Jyn Erso–a human female criminal who would later become a key figure in the theft of the Death Star plans–from a labor camp that was used by the Galactic Empire on the planet Wobani.
